items.description: Ha Tien is a charming coastal city in Vietnam's Kien Giang province, near the Cambodian border. It is known for its picturesque landscapes, including beaches and limestone karst formations.
Binh Duong Industrial Parks are a key economic hub in southern Vietnam, attracting significant foreign investment. These parks play a crucial role in the region's manufacturing and export sectors.
facts: Major economic center in southern Vietnam.

items.description: Thien Mu Pagoda is a historic seven-story pagoda located on the Perfume River in Hue, Vietnam. It is one of the oldest and most beautiful religious structures in the city.
